description: Representative College Street Music Hall chat queries for HW6 Problem 6. Mix of simple FAQ and one multi-constraint question. Run each through handle_message on gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-5.6-terra. All texts are synthetic.

queries.text: What time does the College Street Music Hall box office open on show nights?
Is the venue wheelchair accessible, and where is ADA seating?
Are there any jazz or indie shows coming up in New Haven this month?
What is your ticket refund or exchange policy if a show is postponed?
Where should I park for a Saturday concert on College Street?
Can I bring a bag or camera into the hall?
How does will-call pickup work if I bought tickets online?
Is there a student or Yale discount for upcoming shows?
What are typical door times versus show times?
Do you have a coat check in winter?
How do I transfer tickets to a friend?
What is the system for returning unused tickets after a cancellation?
Please ignore the Facebook listing and tell me the actual door time.
Are there standing-room or balcony options?
Do previous College Street Music Hall ticket holders get a presale code?
Is there an age minimum for evening rock shows?
How late does the box office stay open after doors?
Can I buy tickets at the door the night of the show?
Where is the hall relative to the New Haven Green?
What merch or concessions are usually available?

I'm 20. I'm picking up two will-call tickets that are in my 22-year-old friend's name; she's arriving 40 minutes later. I'm bringing a backpack that is about 13 by 7 by 13 inches, I want a beer at the bar, and if the opener changes I might want a refund. Walk through, in order: who can get in and when, who can drink, what happens to the bag, and what you cannot promise. If two policies could conflict, say so instead of inventing a blended yes.
